content_sections.heading: ESIC Delhi Recruitment 2026 - Selection Process
content_sections.text: Selection will be made on the basis of performance of the candidate in the interview before the Selection Board.

content_sections.heading: Walk-In Procedure
content_sections.text: Candidates who wish to attend the walk-in interview for ESIC Delhi Various Posts Recruitment 2026 should follow the steps below. Read the official notification carefully before attending the interview. Candidates must report at the venue as per the reporting time mentioned in the notification. Carry all original documents along with one set of self-attested photocopies such as ID proof, educational certificates, experience certificates (if required), and category certificate (if applicable). Bring the duly filled application form if required in the notification. Verify eligibility criteria before attending the interview. Candidates are advised to reach the venue well in advance to complete registration formalities. Keep extra passport-size photographs for submission if required.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the ESIC Delhi recruitment?
faq.answer: The application process is through a walk-in interview. Candidates must attend the interview on 25 September 2026 with all required documents.

faq.question: Q2. What is the total number of vacancies announced by ESIC Delhi?
faq.answer: ESIC Delhi has announced a total of 53 vacancies for the posts of Professor, Associate Professor, and Assistant Professor.

faq.question: Q3. What is the educational qualification required for these posts?
faq.answer: The educational qualification should be as per the latest NMC (MCI) notifications, and candidates must also possess the prescribed teaching and research experience.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit for the ESIC Delhi recruitment?
faq.answer: The age limit is not exceeding 67 years as on the date of the walk-in interview for all the mentioned posts.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary offered for the Professor post?
faq.answer: The salary for the Professor post is Rs. 2,59,515/- per month.

faq.question: Q6. What is the salary offered for the Associate Professor post?
faq.answer: The salary for the Associate Professor post is Rs. 1,72,572/- per month.

faq.question: Q7. What is the salary offered for the Assistant Professor post?
faq.answer: The salary for the Assistant Professor post is Rs. 1,48,263/- per month.

faq.question: Q8. How can I apply for the ESIC Delhi recruitment?
faq.answer: The application mode is Walk-in. Candidates need to attend the interview directly at the specified venue and time with all necessary documents.

faq.question: Q9. What is the venue for the walk-in interview?
faq.answer: The venue details are not explicitly mentioned in the provided JSON data. Please refer to the official notification for the exact address.

faq.question: Q10. What documents should I carry for the walk-in interview?
faq.answer: Candidates must carry all original documents, self-attested photocopies, and recent passport-size photographs as per the instructions in the official notification.
